tasks.title: Fresh-eyes usability test: real pharmacist day simulation + fix tasks
tasks.brief: Owner Ahmed wants tonight another independent UX/usability inspection of the CURRENT repo frontend (main, includes UX1-UX35). Do not duplicate .nova/qa/ux-pro-report.md, ux-pro2-report.md or the UX37 scope (layout/icons/WhatsApp/warehouses); read them first. Run locally only (Playwright headless, desktop 1366x768 + mobile 390x844, fake data, no live writes). Simulate a full real pharmacist shift in an Egyptian retail pharmacy as a scripted scenario: open shift, 30 mixed sales (barcode, name search with typos/Arabic-English mix, partial strips, discounts, split payment, credit customer), 3 returns, 2 receivings with expiry/batch, shortage handling, debt collection, chronic refill, end-of-day close and report. Measure friction: hesitation points, missing defaults, repeated typing, unclear errors, unsafe actions without undo, things a new cashier would not discover, speed under rush hour. Also check first-run/onboarding, search quality (Arabic normalisation أ/ا/ة/ه/ى, partial words), and keyboard-only operation. Write .nova/qa/ux-pro3-report.md in Arabic: executive summary, top 10 friction points with screenshots in .nova/qa/ux-pro3/ (max 30 PNGs), and a section «تطوير مقترح» with the highest-value improvements. Then write .nova/inbox/ux-pro3.json = {"tasks":[...]} ids starting UX60, max 12 small frontend-only fix tasks with tests (click-count assertions where relevant), preserve Black Edition Arabic RTL, backend frozen, no deploys, set after only where truly needed. Do not edit .nova/cloud-queue.json. Commit script, screenshots, report and inbox file on this branch.
tasks.acceptance: Arabic report .nova/qa/ux-pro3-report.md with shift-simulation friction findings and screenshots; valid .nova/inbox/ux-pro3.json with UX60+ frontend-only tasks with tests; no live writes, no deploy.
